Tucked inside the bustling Gaisano Mall Davao is a charming little Starbucks branch that, while modest in size, more than makes up for it with its warm and inviting vibe. Whether you're looking for a quick caffeine fix, a place to catch up on emails, or simply somewhere to unwind, this cozy café is worth checking out. From the moment you walk in, the ambiance pulls you in — soft lighting, calm energy, and a mix of seating options that cater to both solo visitors and small groups. It's a compact space, sure, but it doesn't feel cramped. The layout makes smart use of what's available, and the stylish island counter adds a modern, functional flair. For digital nomads or anyone needing to charge up, there are power outlets available, though you might need to do a little hunting to find them. Just a heads-up for persons with disabilities (PWDs): the tight layout might make navigation a bit of a challenge. Now, here's a funny little moment — the barista didn't quite catch my name when I ordered, and instead of asking again, they just made one up. So there I was, on the little corner at the back of the island counter, sipping my Caramel Macchiato and eating my Danish Cinnamon Bread as Niel. Who's Niel? Who knows? That little Starbucks trick is having a comeback, I guess. Another pleasant surprise? The restroom. Clean, well-maintained, and clearly not an afterthought — always a welcome bonus in any café setting. All in all, Starbucks Gaisano Mall Davao is a great little hideaway amidst the mall chaos. It's not the biggest or flashiest branch, but it nails the basics: comfort, good coffee, and a peaceful spot to pause your day — even if you leave with a new name.

I think they should be a little more considerate about their "No-paper straw on Paper Cups" policy or whatever. Knowing that they are located near San Pedro College which values a no-single-use plastic policy makes it hard for the students to enjoy their drinks—especially those that need frequent mixing. I understand that their paper cups are intended for hot drinks that do not need a straw, but a little consideration would be appreciated for us wanting to enjoy our cold drinks with a straw inside the school.
